description: Prepare a fixed-rate lend on a Midnight market by taking the best ask offers through MidnightBundlesV2. First call `morpho_midnight_get_market` for the loan token and `morpho_midnight_get_book_quote` with side `asks` and the same amount to check the rate and depth. The tool re-quotes the asks book itself. Returns unsigned transactions, approval and MidnightBundlesV2 authorization first, plus a simulation and warnings.

amount.description: Loan token amount to lend, in human-readable decimals (e.g. "100")

marketId.description: Midnight market ID (`market_id` from the Midnight read tools)

slippage.description: Slippage percentage applied to the book quote (e.g. "0.5" = 0.5%). Bounds the units filled at the quoted average price.

userAddress.description: Account that sends the transactions and owns the position

name: morpho_prepare_midnight_take_lend
